name: Tilapias
description: Tilapias - the source's Tilapias compartment: the blackchin tilapia (Sarotherodon melanotheron) and Tilapia guineensis, herbivorous cichlids of the creek that browse phytoplankton and benthic microalgae with a large helping of detritus. Functional group pooling the source's two tilapia species, measured together.
